content.short: Kaza is a Web3 service marketplace for freelancers and clients.
content.description: Kaza is a Web3 service marketplace that brings freelancers and clients together for secure, efficient collaboration. The platform prioritizes safe, seamless transactions by keeping funds in escrow until a project is finished, protecting both sides and enabling smooth payouts to sellers. It supports multiple chains - Polygon, Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Avalanche, and Arbitrum - and makes it possible for freelancers to earn Polygon (MATIC) for completed work, reinforcing cross-chain collaboration.
content.meta: Kaza is a Web3 service marketplace for freelancers and clients, with a secure, efficient platform. Discover Kaza and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
